common_model: Accepted G02.var01 two explicit position modes and direct half-hour system CM; both mode FRQ values set to 50000 per million OPHOURS, Control.NREPS set to 256, fixed seed 1, horizon 36 and three scheduled two-hour missions retained. The shared changes from parent keep event probability away from near-saturation.

single_factor_variants.qty-two: Only POS-B MaterielStructure QTYPM1 to 2 relative to baseline
single_factor_variants.env-two: Only POS-B MaterielStructure ENVF1.0 to 2.0 relative to baseline

pre_run_hypothesis: All three models import/export exactly with zero conversion errors and complete 256 native replications. Multiplying POS-B quantity or environment factor should increase reported aggregate failure demand relative to the common baseline if the documented frequency propagation applies. The fixed-seed first-only ENLOG is not the aggregate; exact native values and uncertainty will be observed, not predeclared.
acceptance_requires: Guarded session-0 SSH with the host-wide Issue #18 mutex and GUI PID 13340 continuity.
Four native steps, exact populated-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors and nonempty valid report/log.
Correct 256-replication aggregate System failure/repair ledger, mission metrics and terminal state for each model; first-only ENLOG classified separately.
Single-factor QTYPM and ENVF contrasts analyzed with uncertainty and independently replayed from raw evidence.
limitations: One fixed seed panel and finite replication count cannot establish all parameter values, seeds or population rates.
MaterielStructure quantity and environment factors do not themselves establish physical replacement multiplicity or position-specific PM behavior.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
